summary: rows 6b and 6c of the installer suite on i686, the recovery system's SSH key on an installed disk, on the tree's recovery init and installer

argv: tag=; [ ! -f krffs/recovery_authorized_keys ] || tag=-with-key; make -s -j8 rach2 utils krffs ARCH=i686 </dev/null && rm -f build/images/rach2-recovery*.krffs build/images/rach2-recovery*.iso build/images/installer-test.disk build/images/install-test-stick.img build/utils/sbin/init-recovery && make -s utils ARCH=i686 </dev/null && make -s -j8 build/images/install-test-stick.img build/images/installer-test.disk build/tests/system/harness build/tests/system/runutil ARCH=i686 </dev/null && cp build/utils/sbin/init-recovery ${WORK}/init-recovery && rm -f ${WORK}/rach2-install && build/krffs/readfile.krffs build/images/rach2-recovery$tag.krffs /bin/rach2-install ${WORK}/rach2-install

rm -rf ${WORK}/rows; status=0; sh tests/system/suites/installer.sh build/images/install-test-stick.img build/images/installer-test.disk build/tests/system/harness ${WORK}/rows "$(cat krffs/rach2_demo_password)" build/images/install-test-stick.img build/images/installer-test.disk 2331 unused krffs/rach2_demo_ed25519 recoverykey >${WORK}/rows.log 2>&1 || status=$?; cat ${WORK}/rows.log; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then for line in 'row 6b: root logs in to the recovery system with the key the install placed: OK' 'row 6c: and nothing answers SSH: OK'; do grep -Fq "$line" ${WORK}/rows.log || { echo "installer-proof: FAIL: missing: $line"; status=1; }; done; fi; exit $status

faults.name: init-mutated
faults.summary: the recovery init does not read the disk's key, since it asks the boot line for a slot no boot names

faults.name: installer-mutated
faults.summary: the installer does not copy the key it was given to the recovery partition

lines: FAIL: row 6b: the recovery partition's key file holds

faults.name: server-always
faults.summary: the recovery init starts its SSH server with no key to let in

lines: FAIL: row 6c: init started an SSH server on a recovery system with no key

faults.name: server-late
faults.summary: the recovery init starts its SSH server one turn of its loop late, after its first test for a key

lines: FAIL: row 6c: init started an SSH server on a recovery system with no key
